title: Charlie Kirk and the Rise of Political Violence

reader_summary.overview: The way that we go back to the era that we all look at and say, wow. The way that we get back to that is speaking up. It's doing exactly what Charlie did. key_points.text: Today, we're sharing a conversation from honestly with Barry Weiss at the Freed Press featuring A16Z General Partner, Katherine Boyle.

key_points.text: In the wake of Charlie Kirk's assassination, Katherine reflects on courage, martyrdom.
key_points.evidence_quote: In the wake of Charlie Kirk's assassination, Katherine reflects on courage, martyrdom, and what it means to speak up in a political climate where words and debate are increasingly met with violence.
